notes.title: TRAILS - v1.3
notes.content: [h2]New[/h2][list][*][p]added an option to change the ship colors[/p][/*][*][p]added an option to remove controller button icons[/p][/*][*][p]touch devices can now be used properly on the overworld[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improved[/h2][list][*][p]fixed some Clumsy Button Assignments: pressing CTRL while drawing a path with the mouse should not lead to errors anymore[/p][/*][*][p]stepping through the current solution via hotkey or timeline now animates the current step[/p][/*][*][p]significantly improved performance on low-end hardware[/p][/*][*][p]locking paths is now indicated more clearly[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: added an option to change the ship colors
added an option to remove controller button icons
touch devices can now be used properly on the overworld

tags.bug: fixed some Clumsy Button Assignments: pressing CTRL while drawing a path with the mouse should not lead to errors anymore

tags.feature: stepping through the current solution via hotkey or timeline now animates the current step
significantly improved performance on low-end hardware
locking paths is now indicated more clearly
